workflows: backend.yml — Go lint (golangci-lint v1.64.8) + test + build

backend.name: SawitHub Backend (User-Facing)
internal_packages: farmcore — Core farm operations (plots, harvests, maintenance, schedules)
handler — HTTP request handlers (61 handler functions)
middleware — HTTP middleware (auth, rate limit, cache, security)

middleware.name: AuthMiddleware
middleware.purpose: JWT validation (Bearer or cookie), presence tracking every 1min

middleware.name: SubscriptionContext
middleware.purpose: Loads subscription status into request context

middleware.name: CacheInvalidation
middleware.purpose: Clears user cache on POST/PUT/DELETE mutations

workers.name: BillingReminderWorker
workers.purpose: Sends subscription renewal & trial expiry reminder emails

admin_backend.name: SawitHub Admin Backend
internal_packages: middleware — HTTP middleware (AdminAuth, RateLimit, CORS, etc.)
extra_docs: docs/openapi.yaml — OpenAPI spec (used by admin-frontend gen:types script)

databases.name: admin_db
databases.note: Admin-only data; falls back to main DB if not set

frontend.name: @sawithub/frontend
frontend.purpose: User-facing SaaS application for palm oil plantation management

context_providers: FarmContext — farms (lahans), subscription status, active farm management

environment_variables: VITE_API_BASE_URL — Backend API base URL (defaults to /api)
VITE_ALLOW_MOCK_BILLING — staging/test flag for mock payments

admin_frontend.name: @sawithub/admin-frontend
admin_frontend.purpose: Admin control panel — user management, analytics, system monitoring, revenue

database.tool: Custom SQL execution (lexical order: DDL then DML files)

redis_config.purpose: Single source of truth for Redis configuration and key conventions

types: User — user_id, public_id, email, username, full_name, phone, role, timestamps, preferences
Lahan — id_lahan, nama_kebun, jenis_bibit, lokasi, luas_ha, jumlah_pohon, tahun_tanam
PanenRow — harvest entry with all calculated fields
PerawatanRow — maintenance entry with material and labor costs
PendapatanRow — income entry with gross/net fields
zod_schemas: signupSchema / SignupInput — full_name, email, username (3+ alphanumeric+underscore), password (8+ chars)
lahanSchema / LahanInput — farm registration with luas_ha > 0, tahun_tanam 1900-current
panenSchema / PanenInput — harvest entry with lahan reference

infisical_sync.purpose: Sync Railway JSON env vars to Infisical secrets manager

notable_columns: trial_farm_create_used, trial_panen_used, trial_perawatan_used, trial_jadwal_used, trial_harvest_used, trial_report_export_used

t_sawit_hub_field_checklist_run_items.purpose: Individual items within a checklist run

t_sawit_hub_harga_tbs.purpose: Fresh Fruit Bunch (TBS) commodity price tracking

frontend → backend.auth: JWT Bearer token (stored in localStorage via Zustand)

admin_frontend → admin_backend.auth: JWT Bearer token (stored in localStorage via Zustand, key: sawit_admin_auth)

admin_frontend → admin_backend (type gen.note: apps/admin-frontend/scripts/gen:types uses apps/admin-backend/docs/openapi.yaml to generate src/api/types.generated.ts

mysql.note: Admin backend reads from the same main DB as user backend for user management

railway.purpose: Cloud hosting + managed Redis + managed MySQL

supabase.purpose: Optional secondary backend (integration ready, not primary)

infisical.purpose: Secrets management sync from Railway env vars

summary.auth_mechanism: JWT HMAC-SHA256 (separate secrets per service: JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_JWT_SECRET)
summary.domain: sawithub.com (palm oil plantation management SaaS, Indonesian market)
